parent_objective: export replay-selected local-action recovery targets for the M383 exact repair residual

public_gates: recover target export preserves existing actor input contract
selected actions must come from replay/local-search margin improvement, not oracle actor inputs
exported corpus must load through the M383 recovery loader
no-update exact repair smoke must report finite recovery terms
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not replace direct steer/throttle/brake output
do not treat bootstrap preferred actions as recovered targets
hypothesis: Replay-selected one-step local action targets can be exported for the old-key gap-tail rows so the M383 recovery residual is aligned with actual terminal-margin recovery instead of the misaligned old-key surrogate.
success_criteria: export a real old-key recovery corpus with observation hidden action weight and row-id arrays
record the candidate action grid or sampling rule and the selected terminal-margin improvement per row
reject rows that do not improve normal-history terminal margin or mark them as base-retention rows
the exported corpus loads through load_old_key_recovery_snippets
a no-update exact repair smoke reports finite recovery terms
failure_criteria: exported targets are just copied preferred actions without replay selection
target search uses forbidden deployable actor inputs

commands.name: target_export
commands.command: Export replay-selected local recovery targets from M380 cumulative old-key gap-tail rows; no PPO.

decision_rule: M384 can admit a no-PPO repair proof probe only if recovery targets are selected by replay/local-search terminal-margin evidence and the M383 recovery residual can read them without changing the actor contract.
next_blocker: pending M384 old-key local recovery target export
